Introduction

Yang Jeongin, known as I.N, is a South Korean singer-songwriter and the youngest member of the boy group Stray Kids under JYP Entertainment. He joined the company after a second audition in Busan and was introduced through the survival show Stray Kids in 2017, officially debuting with the group on March 25, 2018.

Beyond music, I.N has been recognized for his philanthropy, becoming the youngest member of the Green Noble Club in 2024 after donating 100 million KRW to ChildFund Korea. In 2025, he expanded his influence into fashion, being named Brand Ambassador for Bottega Veneta in January and Global Brand Ambassador for Damiani in May.
